{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing 'sex' to ensure clean analysis
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['sex'])

# Now compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify the species with the highest mean flipper length
best_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {best_species}")"}
